packageType.standard: Standard package · tests are generated on a judge

howTo.title: How-to for problem setters

steps.access: Open the problem on polygon.codeforces.com; in Manage access, add {account} with Read access.
steps.package: Commit your changes and build a full package (Packages, Create package, Full); wait until it is READY.
steps.paste: Copy the address of the problem page (https://polygon.codeforces.com/p…/owner/name) and paste it into Import from Polygon on QHHOJ.

howTo.readIsEnough: Read access is enough: QHHOJ changes nothing on Polygon. Treat the link like a password: anyone who has it and may import on QHHOJ can import the problem.

check.hint: Calls Polygon once with the saved key and secret; save your changes before testing.
check.ok: Connected at {time}. Polygon accepts the key of {account}: {count} problems are shared with the account.

wizard.title: Import from Polygon
wizard.lead: Give the {account} account Read access on Polygon, paste the problem link, configure it, then follow the import.

link.label: Polygon problem link
link.hint: On Polygon, give {account} Read access to the problem, then paste the address of its page.
link.notLinked: Not linked to any QHHOJ problem yet.

invalid.title: That is not a Polygon problem link
invalid.body: Paste the full address of the problem page: https://polygon.codeforces.com/p…/owner/name.

refused.title: {account} cannot open this link
refused.body: Give the {account} account READ access on Polygon (Manage access), then copy the link again from the problem page.

noPackage.title: Build a package first
noPackage.body: QHHOJ checks the link against the newest package, so the problem needs at least one READY package. Build a full package on Polygon, then check again.

notReady.title: No READY package to import
notReady.body: The newest package is not READY: it is still building or it failed. On Polygon, open Packages and build a full or standard package; if one is RUNNING, wait until it finishes.

linked.title: Already on QHHOJ
linked.withCode: This Polygon problem is linked to {code}. Open it and use Sync.
linked.hidden: This Polygon problem is already linked to a QHHOJ problem.

notConnected.title: Polygon is not connected
notConnected.bodyAdmin: The site has no Polygon API key or secret yet, so links cannot be checked. You can still import a .zip file.
notConnected.bodyAsk: The site has no Polygon API key yet. Ask an administrator to add one; meanwhile a .zip file still imports.

source.label: Source

taken.limits: Time and memory limits and partial scoring

source.kept: Code, points, group, types, authors, curators and allowed languages. Later syncs never overwrite these.

configure.title: Configure the import
configure.lead: The same as a .zip import. Statements, tests and the checker come from the Polygon package; the rest are QHHOJ settings.
configure.autoSync: Sync automatically on a new package
configure.autoSyncHint: When the owner builds a READY package newer than r{revision}, QHHOJ imports the statements, tests and checker again (checked every 10 minutes, deferred while a contest using the problem runs).

progress.title: Importing from Polygon
progress.lead: The package is processed in the background. You may leave; the import keeps running and stays at this address for 24 hours.

panel.title: Polygon link

revisionText.newer: Package #{id} of r{revision} is built (READY). Sync to take the new version.
revisionText.syncFailed: Newest package on Polygon: r{revision}, {state}. The last sync failed; the problem keeps the old version.
revisionText.notReady: The newest package on Polygon is {state}; it cannot be synced yet.
revisionText.unknown: Polygon cannot be asked right now: not connected, unreachable, or the account lost read access.

panel.syncFailed: The sync at {date} failed: {reason} The problem was not changed.
panel.syncBlocked: Syncing needs a READY package on Polygon.
panel.autoSyncOn: A newer READY package re-imports the statements, tests and checker. On.
panel.autoSyncOff: A newer READY package re-imports the statements, tests and checker. Off.
panel.readOnly: {needs} to sync, switch auto-sync or unlink.

syncConfirm.title: Sync {code} from Polygon?
syncConfirm.overwrites: The sync overwrites on QHHOJ: statements and translations, the tutorial, tests, the checker, time and memory limits.
syncConfirm.lost: Every edit to those on QHHOJ since the last import is lost; copy it to Polygon first if you need it.
syncConfirm.kept: Kept: code, points, group, types, authors, curators, allowed languages.

unlinkConfirm.title: Unlink {code} from Polygon?
unlinkConfirm.body: The problem's content stays; only syncing stops (auto-sync too). To link again, import the problem in update mode.

history.title: Imports and syncs, newest first
history.empty: No import or sync has been recorded yet.
